proposals.title: Reason and corrective action on the same screen
proposals.observation: Zerodha and Angel One document multiple rejection causes with corrections.
proposals.hypothesis: Documented fixes may still be hard to find or act on when they live in separate help pages.
proposals.decision: Show the specific problem and the corrective action together on the status screen.
proposals.effect: Hypothesised: more users complete the correction. Not measured.
proposals.alternatives: Link out to help articles; send the fix only by email/SMS.
proposals.tradeoff: Needs structured rejection reasons from the verification backend.
proposals.validation: Usability test: find and perform the correction from a rejected state.

proposals.title: Separate "Waiting for you" from "Under external review"
proposals.observation: Zerodha documents that KRA verification may delay activation.
proposals.hypothesis: Users may not know whether a delay needs their action or depends on an external party.
proposals.decision: Split pending states into user-action and external-review groups with a named next step.
proposals.effect: Hypothesised: fewer status-related support contacts. Not measured.
proposals.alternatives: One generic "Pending" state; a single progress bar.
proposals.tradeoff: Requires reliable knowledge of which party holds the application.
proposals.validation: Five-second test and task: "what do I need to do now?".

proposals.title: Show modification prerequisites before starting
proposals.observation: Groww starts address changes through support; Angel One uses DigiLocker and e-sign; Zerodha documents online and offline procedures.
proposals.hypothesis: Routes differ by platform, so users may begin a change they cannot finish online.
proposals.decision: Show eligibility, required documents and re-verification before any form field.
proposals.effect: Hypothesised: higher initiation-to-completion rate. Not measured.
proposals.alternatives: Show requirements only after the form is filled; a chatbot triage.
proposals.tradeoff: Adds a screen before editing; eligibility must be accurate.
proposals.validation: A/B or moderated test comparing prerequisites-first with form-first.

proposals.title: Group eligible changes into one request
proposals.observation: Angel One documents online address, email and mobile modification requests.
proposals.hypothesis: Separate requests for related changes may cause repeated steps.
proposals.decision: Let eligible changes share one request while keeping the verification each needs.
proposals.effect: Hypothesised: fewer repeated steps. Not measured.
proposals.tradeoff: Regulatory rules may force separate processes for some fields.
proposals.validation: Task study with a two-field change.

proposals.title: Timing guidance with stated uncertainty
proposals.observation: Published processing windows differ: Zerodha 48 working hours, Groww 2 working days, Angel One up to 3 working days.
proposals.hypothesis: A single countdown would overpromise because windows depend on KRA and review.
proposals.decision: Show the platform's published window as guidance, with what could extend it.
proposals.alternatives: No timing at all; a precise ETA.
